purpose: Find the highest arrival rate at which 1000 share-group members x concurrency 10 keep north-star queue time near the Redis reference (36 / 77 / 100 ms), ramping arrival at 8, 16, 32, and 64 ready partitions with the record-lock window fixed at 4000.

execution_time_ms.distribution: lognormal, sigma=ln(646/475)/(2.326-1.645), mean 250 ms, seeded by task ID

acceptance.reference: Redis production queue time 36 / 77 / 100 ms p50 / p95 / p99
acceptance.definition: all tasks completed exactly once, enqueue >= 99% of requested, completions end within max_tail_seconds of production, and queue percentiles within limits

notes: One run per point. Per partition count, arrival was ramped upward until the first point failed the acceptance limits; some partition counts were then probed at lower or intermediate rates. Kafka recreated per point.
